contribution.summary: Implement a canonical default(ExactRational) zero through offset denominator storage, preserve exact BigInteger arithmetic and record targeted GREEN evidence; advance only T2-G while leaving integration and resource-budget verification to T2-V.
contribution.value: Eliminates the durable RS009 zero-denominator default defect without relying on floating-point conversion, rewriting AURA, or imposing arbitrary numeric size limits.
debtChanges: The T2-V verification must qualify resource-budget handling for unbounded BigInteger input/intermediates and broader integration. GREEN claims only the tested default invariant and exact arithmetic.
contribution.nextAction: Verify canonical default equality, formatting, operators, large exact intermediates, integration and resource-budget policy before closing T2.
